judgments.reason: 'INR 1.6' appears literally in the vignette and an elevated INR clinically supports coagulopathy as a component of the completed diagnosis label.

'ammonia 55 μmol/L' appears literally in the vignette, but an ammonia of 55 μmol/L is only mildly elevated and is not the primary clinical support for encephalopathy; the encephalopathy is better supported by 'altered mentation' and 'asterixis.' More importantly, the support_span is attributed to supporting the full modifier label including encephalopathy, yet the ammonia value alone does not clinically confirm encephalopathy—the vignette's direct clinical findings (altered mentation, asterixis) are the relevant support, not this borderline ammonia level.

'total bilirubin 15.1 mg/dL (direct 6.2 mg/dL)' appears literally in the vignette and a markedly elevated total bilirubin clinically supports the 'elevated bilirubin' component of the completed diagnosis label.
